articles.full_text:
Sida loo jabsaday xogta FBI: Askarta oo ka cabsi qaba kana caraysan in xogtooda si khatar leh loogu xadgudbay
Published
Waqtiga akhriska: 7 daqiiqo
Askar ka tirsan FBI-da oo hadda shaqeeya iyo kuwo horey uga tirsanaa ayaa BBC News u sheegay inay argagax ku jiraan, iyagoo muujiyay caro iyo walbahaar xooggan oo ka dhashay weerar dhanka internet-ka ah oo la rumeysan yahay inuu bannaanka soo dhigay xog xasaasi ah oo ku saabsan dhammaan shaqaalaha hay'adda.
"Tani waa musiibo dhab ah oo ku habsatay wakiilladeenna qarsoodiga ah," ayuu yiri mid ka mid ah saraakiishii hore ee FBI-da, isagoo si weyn uga walaacsan amniga iyo badbaadada asxaabtiisii hore ee shaqada.
Sarkaalkan oo horey uga soo shaqeeyay la-dagaallanka dambiyada internet-ka ayaa sheegay inuu ka mid yahay koox isku xiran oo ay ku jiraan Askar hadda hawl-gal ah, kuwaas oo dhammaantood ay heysato cabsi ah in xogtooda gaarka ah ay dhowaan si fudud ugu faafto internet-ka, ayna gacanta u gasho dambiilayaal iyo sirdoonno ka socda dowladaha cadawga ah.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in shaqaaluhu ay ka baqayaan in si gaar ah loo beegsado, ama in dambiilayaashu ay xogtaas u adeegsadaan khiyaanooyin casri ah oo u muuqda kuwo dhab ah, sida farriimo lagu kalsoonaan karo oo lagu marin-habaabiyo, isku-dayo wax-isdaba-marin ah iyo cadaadisyo laaluush ah.
Kooxda wax jabsata ee loo yaqaan ShinyHunters ayaa ku hanjabtay in haddii dalabaadkeeda aan loo hoggaansamin, ay muddo afar maalmood gudahood ah ku daabici doonto dhammaan xogtii ay xaday iyo dukumeentiyadii la socday.
Qaar ka mid ah wakiillada ayaa sidoo kale cabsi weyn ka muujiyay suurtagalnimada inay weerarro toos ah kala kulmaan burcadda internet-ka ah ee ay hore u soo baareen.
"Mid ka mid ah qodobbada ugu badan ee aan kaga hadlayno fagaarayaasha wada-hadallada waa khatarta weerarrada cagajugleynta ah ee ay abaabulaan kooxo dhalinyaro ah oo ku takhasusay dambiyada internet-ka, kuwaas oo adeegyada gurmadka degdegga ah ugu yeera guryaha dadka si been ah," ayuu yiri sarkaalkii hore ee FBI-da.
"Waxay xogtan u adeegsan karaan si ay dhibaato ugu geystaan wakiillada FBI-da ee soo baaray dacwadohooda," ayuu hadalkiisa ku daray.
Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp.
Halkaan kaga soo biir
Dhamaadka xayeysiinta
Burcadda la midka ah kuwa loo yaqaan ShinyHunters - oo la rumeysan yahay inay yihiin kooxo dhalinyaro ah oo ku hadla Ingiriisiga - ayaa horay loola xiriiriyay falal halis ah oo ay ka mid yihiin _swatting-ka_ iyo xitaa tuurista bambooyinka gubaya oo lala beegsanayo saraakiisha amniga iyo dadka ay isku dhacsan yihiin.
Swatting-ku waa khiyaano ay dambiilayaashu ku sameeyaan wicitaan been ah oo degdeg ah, taas oo sababta in ciidanka gaarka ah ee sida culus u hubeysan ee Mareykanka looga yaqaan SWAT ay si lama-filaan ah u weeraraan guryaha dad aan waxba galabsan.
Kooxda ayaa sheegatay inay Isniintii jabisay nidaamyadii FBI-da, kadibna faahfaahinta weerarka ay ku faafisay shabakadda qarsoon ee darknet-ka.
Ilaa hadda FBI-du kama aysan hadlin su'aalaha laga weydiiyay arrintan.
Balse Arbacadii, hay'addu waxay qiratay in la jabsaday, iyadoo sheegtay inay si dardar leh u waddo baaritaan lagu ogaanayo sida wax u dhaceen.
Michael McPherson oo horey uga tirsanaa FBI-da, haddana ah madaxa hawlaha amniga ee shirkadda teknolojiyadda ee ReliaQuest, ayaa sheegay in jabsigani uu abuurayo "khatar amni oo culus oo si toos ah u saameyneysa nabadgelyada wakiillada iyo tan qoysaskoodaba".
Wuxuu xusay in wakiilladu ay si fiican u garanayaan halista ku lammaan shaqadooda.
"Hayeeshii, dhacdadan la soo weriyay waxay bannaanka soo dhigtay xog shaqsiyeed oo xasaasi ah, sida halka ay deggan yihiin iyo sida loola xiriiri karo, taas oo khatar toos ah ku noqon karta qoysaska wakiillada oo caadiyan ka fogaa saameynta iyo halista shaqadan," ayuu yiri McPherson.
Kooxda ShinyHunters ayaa u bandhigtay saxafiyiinta qaybo ka mid ah xogtii ay sheegeen inay la baxeen, iyagoo ku lifaaqay dalab madax-furasho ah.
Muunadaha la soo bandhigay ayaa u muuqda kuwo dhab ah, waxaana ku jira magacyo, goobaha ay deggan yihiin, lambarrada taleefanka, calaamadaha aqoonsiga, xilalka ay hayaan, iyo xog ku saabsan lammaanayaashooda.
Diiwaannadan ayaa la rumeysan yahay inay khuseeyaan kumanaan wakiil ah, oo ay ku jiraan mas'uuliyiin sare sida ku-xigeennada agaasimaha.
Dambiilayaasha ayaa sidoo kale u muuqda inay gacanta ku hayaan xog caafimaad oo xasaasi ah oo ku saabsan kumanaan wakiil ah.
BBC News ayaa heshay muunado ka mid ah baaritaannada caafimaad ee lagu go'aamiyo in qofku shaqada u qalmo, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan natiijooyin dhiig iyo kaadi, iyo warbixinno caafimaad oo xusaya xaalado ay ka mid tahay xasaasiyadda ka dhalata cunista cuntada badda ee qolofleyda leh iyo muuska.
Xilligan, magacyada saxda ah ee wakiillada, halka ay ku nool yihiin, iyo faahfaahintooda caafimaad oo ay ku jiraan arrimo ay ka mid yihiin "dhiig kaadida ku jira" iyo "kororka dufanka dhiigga" ayaa ku jira gacmaha burcadda.
Cynthia Kaiser, oo mar soo noqotay ku-xigeenka agaasimaha dhinaca Cyber-ka ee FBI-da, islamarkaana hadda hoggaamisa Xarunta Cilmi-baarista ee Halcyon, ayaa sheegtay in kooxda ShinyHunters ay u muuqato inay horeyba u lumisay gacan-ku-hayntii qaar ka mid ah xogta, taas oo hadda ku wareegaysa kooxo kala duwan oo ku sugan baraha internet-ka, isla markaana ay dhaawac geysan karto xitaa ka hor inta aan la shaacin xogta ugu badan.
"Waxaa laga yaabaa in qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah dhibaatadu ay horayba u dhacday, oo sidii aan ku aragnay xogtii hore ee FBI-da ee la jabsaday, macluumaadkan wuxuu ku sii wareegi karaa dark web-ka muddo sanado ah," ayay tiri.
Waxa kale oo jira cabsi la xiriirta saameynta ay xog-jebintani ku yeelan karto amniga qaranka, sida in shaqaalaha ay bartilmaameed u noqdaan isku-dayo shisheeye oo ay wadaan sirdoonnada cadawga ah si loo qorto.
Cabsida ka dhalan karta
Marka laga soo tago cabsida jirta, dad badan oo ka mid ah kuwii ay BBC-du la xiriirtay ayaa muujiyay inay aad uga xun yihiin FBI-da oo u oggolaatay in xogtu gacanta u gasho kooxaha jabsiga.
Dhanka farsamada, dhacdadani waa ceeb weyn oo soo food saartay FBI-da, maadaama ShinyHunters aysan ahayn koox caan ku ah xeelado jabsasho oo aad u casrisan.
Mid ka mid ah saraakiishii hore ee dhinaca amniga internet-ka ayaa sheegay in shaqaalaha FBI-da ay aad uga carooden "dayacaad dhanka amniga ah oo ka timid taxadar la'aan iyo is-daba-marin" taas oo loo arko inay albaabka u furtay in xogta la jabsado.
Sidoo kale, waxaa jira jahwareer weyn oo ku saabsan sida loo wajahayo wixii dhici kara haddii xogta, sidii lagu hanjabay, loo faafiyo toddobaadka soo socda.
FBI-du uma muuqato mid u hoggaansami doonta dalabaadka madax-furashada, halka kooxda jabsatay ay shaacisay inay qorsheyneyso inay xogta ku baahiso barta darknet-ka.
Waxa lala yaabo ah, kooxdu lacag ma dalbaneyso. Balse waxay dooneysaa in FBI-du ay ka laabato warbixin talo-bixin ah oo la soo saaray bishii May, taas oo ay sheegeen inay "ka xanaajisay".
"Hoggaankii hay'adda ayaa lunsan," ayuu iigu sheegay mid ka mid ah baarayaashii hore ee internet-ka.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in shaqaalaha lagu waaniyay inay iska diiwaan-geliyaan adeeg la yiraahdo DeleteMe, oo ka caawiya in xogta gaarka ah laga tirtiro mareegaha ka ganacsada xogta shaqsiga ah - tallaabo uu u arko mid aan waxba ka qabaneyn dhibaatada dhabta ah.
Sida uu sheegay wakiil kale oo hore, waxaa jira argagax xooggan oo ka dhashay in xog-jebin noocan ah ay ka dhacdo gudaha mid ka mid ah hay'adaha fulinta sharciga ee ugu awoodda badan caalamka.
"Waxaad moodi lahayd in xog noocan ah aysan marnaba bannaanka u soo bixi lahayn. Waa wax aad looga argagaxo," ayuu yiri.
*'Waxay hurdada ka kiciyeen libaax'*
Waxa kale oo ceeb ah in koox dhalinyaro ah oo caan ku ah dambiyada internet-ka ay marar badan ka baxsadeen gacanta sharciga, iyagoo geystay jabsiyo waaweyn oo si isdaba-joog ah u dhacay.
Kooxda ShinyHunters ayaa lala xiriiriyay weerarro badan oo madax-furasho ah, oo ay ku jiraan kuwii lagu qaaday shirkadda ciyaaraha ee Rockstar Games iyo goobta waxbarashada ee Canvas.
Kooxdu waxay si joogto ah ula xiriirtaa wariyeyaasha iyadoo adeegsaneysa Telegram, halkaas oo xubnaheedu ay inta badan ku faanaan waxa ay qabsadeen.
"Xafiisku ma yaqaanno sida loola dhaqmo dhalinyarada ku foogan dambiyada internet-ka," ayuu yiri mid ka mid ah wakiilladii hore.
McPherson ayaa sheegay in aan shaki ku jirin in FBI-du dhacdadan si dhab ah u qaadaneyso.
Wuxuu filayaa in hay'addu ay ka faa'iideysan doonto shabakadeeda ballaaran ee iskaashiga caalamiga ah iyo awoodaha ay leedahay "si ay kooxdan u wajahdo cawaaqibka weerarkan geesinimada iyo quudhsiga xambaarsan".
Kaiser ayaa hadalkeeda ku dartay in jabsadayaashu ay ahaayeen "kuwo dayacan oo nacas ah", waxayna uga digtay inay la kulmi doonaan "raadinta xooggan oo ay FBI-du ku dooneyso inay si degdeg ah caddaaladda u hor keento."

articles.title: I flew the future of cheap transatlantic travel – with less legroom and queues for the loo - The Telegraph

articles.full_text:
Etihad’s jets have economy class, business class and first class. I’m not so lucky. United’s Max 8 has United Premium Plus (premium economy to you and me), with seats arranged in pairs across the aisle. Mystifyingly, United calls it “first class” on board, which it most definitely is not. United Economy Plus has a few inches more legroom than basic economy at the back of the bus.
There are no lie-flat beds, just 3,000 miles spent praying the person in front does not recline. Spoiler alert: they always do.
I experienced all three seats flying overnight from Newark to Glasgow and can confidently say you would be more comfortable on a bigger jet if you were in basic economy. The 96 seats have a meagre 30-inch “pitch” (the measure of the distance between seats). You’ll struggle to find a long-haul flight on any airline offering less.
It feels even worse because the ceiling is low and the encroaching overhead bins make it feel cramped. There is no space in the galley to stretch your legs. Worst of all, there are only two minuscule lavatories for 150 passengers, shared across basic economy and Economy Plus. Go before you board.
Basic economy and Economy Plus passengers do get a (flimsy) pillow and blanket, along with headphones to watch films on the rather small seat-back screen. The headrest wraps around my head, so I do not need a neck pillow. The food, which is included in the price of the ticket, is typical economy – beef and potatoes and rigatoni Alfredo on my flight – and there’s a snack bar for breakfast. Soft drinks, juices, beer, wine, tea and coffee are also included.
The price? Return basic economy fares for Newark-Glasgow on the 737 Max can be found during October from £701 per person – or £883 if you add checked luggage and seat selection.
Things begin to look up when I advance into the 54 Economy Plus seats in the first nine rows of the economy cabin. They have a 34-inch seat pitch, which is generous by both short-haul and long-haul standards. Snag the front row and you have almost as much legroom as in Premium Plus, although the seat is narrower because both Economy Plus and economy seats are in groups of three on either side of the aisle.
The food and amenities are the same as in basic economy and it’s a long walk back to join the queue for the loo. The blue mood lighting looks good, though, and helps you to get to sleep. Economy Plus, on October departures, costs from £161 extra per person per flight.
If you can further loosen the purse strings, the best place to stretch out – a bit – is in one of the 16 United Premium Plus seats. These cost around three times more – return fares for Newark-Glasgow start from £2,046 in October (or £2,272 with checked bags and seat selection). The seat provides a decent 37-inch pitch, is 20 inches wide and reclines five inches. Each passenger receives a Saks Fifth Avenue blanket, a (rather small) pillow, plus an amenity kit with eye shades, earplugs, socks, moisturiser and a toothbrush with toothpaste.
Although there are no printed menus, the food is a definite step up from economy – beef short rib, with pecan pie for dessert, all served on china plates on my flight. United is also the only carrier to offer champagne – Laurent-Perrier – in premium economy. My breakfast was fruit and a nut bar with tea or coffee.
The seat-back screen is small by international premium-economy standards and the one lavatory for the 16 passengers is so small I banged my head on the ceiling. Because the door of the aircraft is at the front, you have to turn right to get to the big seats and wait for the 150 other passengers to file past you as they board. Is nothing sacred?
I wasn’t the only one feeling somewhat cramped. Before we took off, Robert Deaton, the First Officer, told me the cockpit on the 737 was “the smallest one in the fleet... Every couple of hours I like to get up and stretch my legs”.
Maybe my nitpicking is unfair. Comparing a 737 between Glasgow and the US with an Airbus A380 double-decker from London is not what regular passengers do.
They know there will always be big planes between London and New York with business-class and first-class cabins. They also know that a plane with one third the number of seats as an A380 is easier to fill and, therefore, opens up the chance for airlines to ply new routes – and that’s a good thing.
As well as Newark to Glasgow, United is also flying narrow-body jets from the US to Amsterdam, Dublin, Marseille, Valencia, Madeira, Ibiza and the Azores. Airlines call these “long and thin” routes – far away and likely to draw a smaller number of passengers than services to the biggest cities, but still enough bums on seats to make a profit.
Passengers are prepared to put up with a rather cramped experience in return for a decent fare to the destination they want to go to, rather than having to connect through a hub. My flight proved the point. It was overbooked. The gate team was offering $1,500 to any passenger prepared to go the next day, more than the price of most passengers’ return tickets. Lucky Glaswegians.

CHARLOTTE, N.C. (WBTV) - The sunshine, warm temperatures and mainly dry conditions will stay in place across the Carolinas for much of this week.
Monday’s temperatures started off cool, in the upper 40s and low 50s. Despite that cool start, high temperatures will still reach the upper 70s and low 80s, close to average for late September.
Warm week ahead
A steady warming trend will take over the rest of the week.
Highs will reach the mid to upper 80s by Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. While those temperatures are close to 10 degrees above normal, they will fall short of the daily records (all set in 2019).
First Alert: Rainy weekend
Another pattern shift will send rain and cooler temperatures back into the Carolinas for the first weekend of October.
Confidence in the specific timing of the heaviest rain is low at this point, but both Saturday and Sunday look generally wet. Have an indoor alternative in mind for any outdoor plans, and pack a poncho if you are heading to the Panthers game Sunday evening.
Check back with the First Alert Weather team for forecast updates through the rest of the week.
Forecast at a glance
Monday: Sunny and warm
Tuesday-Friday: Unseasonably warm
Weekend: First Alert -- rain likely
Download the free WBTV Weather app on your mobile device to receive weather alerts and to get the latest forecast on the go. You can also catch the latest forecast on WBTV’s streaming app -- find it in the app store on your smart TV or streaming device.

Mumbai is likely to receive light rain or thundershowers on Monday and Tuesday, the IMD said. No alert has been issued for the city, while Raigad and several parts of Maharashtra are under a yellow watch for thunderstorms and gusty winds

Mumbai is likely to see light rain or thundershowers on Monday and Tuesday, according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), with no alert issued for the city. The forecast was part of the district-wise bulletin issued by the weather agency at 11.22 am on Monday.
The IMD forecast is valid from 8.30 am on the day of issue to 8.30 am the following day. The probability of the forecast weather has been marked as "very likely" across the Konkan districts.
For Mumbai, the IMD has forecast light rain or thundershowers on Monday and Tuesday. Light rain is also likely on Thursday, October 1, and Friday, October 2, with no thunderstorm mentioned for those days.
Rain forecast for Mumbai, Thane, Palghar and Raigad
Thane is expected to receive light to moderate rain or thundershowers on Monday and Tuesday. Light rain or thundershowers are likely to continue in the district from Wednesday, September 30, to October 2.
Palghar is forecast to receive light rain or thundershowers on all five days, through October 2.
Raigad is expected to receive light to moderate rain or thundershowers on Monday. On Tuesday, the district is under a yellow alert (watch) for thunderstorms with lightning, light to moderate rain and gusty winds of 30-40 kmph at isolated places. Light to moderate rain or thundershowers are forecast to continue through October 2.
Rain forecast across Maharashtra
For Monday, the IMD has issued a yellow alert for thunderstorms with lightning, light to moderate rain and gusty winds of 30-40 kmph at isolated places for the ghats of Pune, ghats of Satara and Sangli.
Light to moderate rain or thundershowers are forecast in Raigad, Ahilyanagar, Pune district, the ghats of Kolhapur and Solapur.
Light rain or thundershowers are likely in Palghar, Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg, Dhule, Nandurbar, Nashik, Kolhapur, Satara, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Beed, Latur and Dharashiv.
The IMD has forecast dry weather in Jalgaon, Jalna, Parbhani, Hingoli and Nanded.
No warning has been listed for Akola, Amravati, Bhandara, Buldhana, Chandrapur, Gadchiroli, Gondia, Nagpur, Wardha, Washim and Yavatmal.
Yellow watch expands on Tuesday
The yellow thunderstorm-and-wind watch is expected to expand on Tuesday to Raigad, Ratnagiri, the ghats of Nashik, Pune, the ghats of Pune, the ghats of Kolhapur, Kolhapur, Satara, the ghats of Satara, Sangli and Solapur.
The ghats of Pune and the ghats of Satara are forecast to experience gusty winds of 40-50 kmph at isolated places on Tuesday.
IMD issues thunderstorm safety advisory
The IMD has advised people to avoid open fields and tall trees during thunderstorms. Residents have also been advised to unplug electrical appliances and stay away from water bodies when lightning is occurring.
Farmers have been advised to harvest ripe crops wherever possible, cover harvested produce, avoid irrigation and chemical sprays during the adverse weather, drain excess water from fields and keep cattle indoors during thunderstorms.

Thai Credit Bank Announces Emergency Relief Measures to Assist Flood-Affected Customers
Thai Credit Bank Public Company Limited (SET: CREDIT) has announced urgent relief measures for customers affected by the recent flooding in Bangkok, its surrounding metropolitan area, and other affected regions nationwide. The initiative aims to alleviate the hardships faced by impacted customers, enhance their liquidity, and support the revitalization of their businesses to ensure continued operations.
Relief measures include the suspension of principal and interest payments for up to two months. Eligibility for these relief measures extends to all loan groups, including SMEs, MSMEs, retail clients, consumer finance customers, as well as nano and micro finance segments.
The application periods are as follows:
- For customers in other regions, applications are available for 45 days from the date of impact.
